evals.expected_output: A report grounded in file:line evidence, with no proposals
expectations: 2-4 investigation axes are chosen and Explore agents are launched in parallel, one per axis
Every claim in the report carries a file:line reference
Facts read from code are distinguished from inferences
The report ends without proposing an implementation or filing an issue

evals.prompt: An Explore agent came back with 'the token is probably refreshed by an interceptor' and no file references.
evals.expected_output: The shallow result is rejected and re-investigated, not written into the report
expectations: The Think Twice pass identifies the result as speculation rather than reading
A follow-up Explore agent is launched scoped to the specific gap
The unverified claim does not appear in the report as a finding

evals.prompt: The investigation cannot determine whether the refresh is retried on 401, because the behavior depends on server configuration.
evals.expected_output: The unknown goes to Open Questions
expectations: The item appears under Open Questions rather than being answered by a plausible guess
The report says what was covered and what was not
No implementation recommendation is made on the basis of the unknown
